description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) INDOMITABLE GUARDIANS (Shadowkeepers, 1 CP) — WP-C5. Fixture cus11e_c5_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE, P2 Custodes, round 2). Setup privileges: the Custodes detachment flipped (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, Trajann's Moment Shackle marked spent (its prompt is not under test), the Custodes unreadied (Martial Ka'tah not under test), straight to the phase under test (the Orks' Fight phase). Pile-ins end; the Ork player (active, selects first) real-clicks the Boyz, assigns every attack to Custodian Guard A and the dock resolves the fight; once the Boyz have fought, enemy_has_fought opens for P2; a real click on 'Use on Custodian Guard...' (on obj_center, eligible to fight) spends 1 CP: the Guard gains Fights First and must be the next unit the Custodes select.
